stories.title: Age Cymru urges Flintshire communities to check on older neighbours during extreme heat
stories.summary: Older people across Flintshire are being urged to take care during this week’s extreme heat, as Age Cymru calls on friends, family and neighbours to check in on those who may be struggling. stories.title: Nine Welsh health and care organisations write to Welsh Government demanding action on corridor care
stories.summary: Nine health and care organisations have written to the Welsh Government’s health minister demanding urgent action on corridor care, the practice of treating patients in hospital corridors, waiting rooms and car parks because no clinical space is available. stories.title: Why Natural Resources Wales is pumping extra water into the River Dee this week
stories.summary: Natural Resources Wales has released extra water into the River Dee to protect fish as temperatures locally are forecast to reach 37°C on Thursday, with amber heat warnings in place for both Wednesday and Thursday. stories.title: Final plans in place for Connah’s Quay Festival at Wepre Park this Saturday
stories.summary: Final preparations are under way for the Connah’s Quay Festival at Wepre Park, with North Wales Police visiting the site on Tuesday to go over the layout ahead of Saturday’s event.
